item.title: MOF announcement: Preliminary balance of payments for the first half of FY2026
item.description: AI summary: The Ministry of Finance published preliminary balance-of-payments results for the first half of fiscal 2026 on 2026-11-10. The current-account surplus narrowed, partly because the trade balance moved into deficit: exports rose 16.5% year on year to JPY 61.7952 trillion, while imports rose 18.8% to JPY 62.8648 trillion. The combined goods and services deficit widened to JPY 2.4899 trillion, while the primary-income surplus narrowed to JPY 21.5343 trillion. This is a statistical announcement, not a regulatory amendment. item.title: FSA revises supervisory guidelines on API-linked banking services and publishes consultation results
item.description: AI summary: The Financial Services Agency (FSA) revised the Comprehensive Guidelines for Supervision of Major Banks, etc. and related guidelines to clarify measures preventing user misunderstanding in services banks provide with other businesses through APIs and similar technologies, and when other businesses' conduct constitutes banking agency intermediation. On 2026-11-06, it published the results of the consultation held from 2026-07-30 to 2026-08-31, which received 21 comments from nine individuals and organizations; the revised guidelines apply from 2026-11-06. The FSA explains that intermediation is assessed on individual facts and service characteristics, including where APIs or AI are used. Although application is immediate, incomplete improvements will not automatically be treated as problematic where appropriate improvement efforts are underway; the FSA nevertheless expects prompt work where arrangements are insufficient.
